title: Survive the zombie
features:
This is a Roblox executor script for a survival minigame. Here's what it does in simple terms:
The Goal — You're dropped onto a dark, foggy map and have to collect 5 golden orbs before the 2-minute timer runs out, all while being chased by a zombie.
The Map — A large 600-stud arena built at a far-off coordinate so it doesn't interfere with the base game. It spawns trees, broken fences, barrels, crates, stone paths, and ground fog to give it a creepy abandoned feel.
The Zombie — A green Roblox dummy with a zombie face that chases you across the map. It deals 18 damage every 0.8 seconds when it gets within arm's reach. If it hits a wall, it uses a pathfinding system (BFS) to route around it rather than getting stuck. Its arms reach forward and its legs animate as it walks.
The Player — You can walk normally or hold Ctrl to sprint, though sprinting drains stamina. If you keep sprinting past empty stamina it hurts you and slows you down. You also carry a flashlight (toggle with F, recharge with E) with a limited battery.
The HUD — Shows a timer, item counter, health bar, stamina bar, battery bar, and a sprint indicator. Getting hit triggers a blood splatter effect on screen.
Winning & Losing — Collect all 5 orbs to win. Run out of time or die and it's game over. Either way the screen fades to black and the script cleans itself up.
